title: Invert Binary Tree
oneLinerQuestion: Invert a binary tree so that left and right children are swapped recursively across all levels.
explanation: Recursively swap the left and right subtrees for every node in the tree. The right subtree containing children [6, 9] inverts internally first, before swapping across the root with left child [2].
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION invertTree(root):
    IF root IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL
    temp = root.left
    root.left = invertTree(root.right)
    root.right = invertTree(temp)
    RETURN root
END FUNCTION
codeLines: IF root IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL

steps.narration: Line 2: Initial tree: Root(4) has left child 2 and right child 7 (with children 6 and 9).
Line 4: Recurse into right subtree Node(7). Inspect its children: left=6, right=9.
Lines 4-5: Swap 7's children: temp = 6; 7.left = 9; 7.right = 6. Children animate across 7's axis.
Line 4: Back at root Node(4). Prepare to swap left subtree (Node 2) and right subtree (Node 7 and its children).
Lines 4-5: Swap root's children: root.left = 7 (along with leaves 9 and 6), root.right = 2. Subtrees animate across main mirror axis.
Line 7: Inversion complete! Left child is now 7 (with children 9, 6) and right child is now 2. RETURN root.

output.label: Tree Inverted (Green Glow)
output.detail: Both internal leaf children and main branches mirror-swapped successfully.
